references.supports: Defines the canonical Tfh surface/transcription-factor phenotype (CXCR5-high, PD-1-high, Bcl-6+, CD4+) and states these cells reside in the germinal center where they act as specialized B helper T cells providing survival and selection signals to GC B cells. CXCR5 and PD-1 here refer to surface protein markers; Bcl-6 (BCL6) is an intracellular transcription factor. Also documents Tfh in human tonsillar tissue.

Describes the light-zone (LZ) as the germinal-center compartment where B cells bind FDC-presented antigen and are selected by T follicular helper (TFH) cell recognition of cognate peptide-MHCII. Establishes the core light-zone selection function of Tfh; markers referenced (pMHCII, TCR) are functional/interaction molecules, not transcriptional.

Places Tfh help spatially in the light zone: LZ B cells capture antigen from FDCs and receive help from cognate Tfh cells, and are selected based on their competency to present antigen to Tfh. Strong T cell selection primes proliferation and re-entry into the dark zone. Confirms the light-zone localisation and selection-help function.

In human tonsil, uses CXCR5 and PD-1 as established markers of Tfh cell maturation and shows GC-Tfh are the CXCR5+ PD-1-high population (with pre-Tfh being CXCR5+ PD-1-low). CXCR5 and PD-1 are measured here as surface proteins by intracellular cytokine staining / flow cytometry; CXCL13 marks an effector subset within GC-Tfh. Directly supports CXCR5-high, PD-1-high protein phenotype of light-zone GC-Tfh in human tonsil.

In human tonsil, defines Tfh by FOXP3-negative, CXCR5+ CD4 T cells and shows ICOS and PD-1 are characteristic of the most mature cells within the GC, with Tfh maturing toward an ICOS+ PD-1+ phenotype. ICOS, PD-1 and CXCR5 are surface protein markers; FOXP3 an intracellular transcription factor. Supports the protein-level activation/maturation phenotype of GC-localised Tfh in tonsil.

Models affinity selection in the light zone as a competition between B cells binding Tfh cells (for costimulation) and loss of B cells from the GC light zone via apoptosis or return to the dark zone. Reinforces the mechanistic role of light-zone Tfh in affinity selection of centrocytes.

justification: Light-zone refinement of CL:0009062 (germinal center T cell). NOTE for curators: no general/tonsil 'germinal center light zone' UBERON term exists (only UBERON:8410052 lymph node germinal center light zone); light-zone locality is carried in the definition text and a general light-zone UBERON term may be worth adding. Species-neutral; surface markers asserted with generic PR classes (BCL6, an intracellular TF, is textual only).

## New term request: light zone germinal center T cell

**Proposed label:** light zone germinal center T cell

**Definition:** A germinal center T cell (germinal center T follicular helper cell) positioned in the germinal center light zone, where it delivers antigen-dependent selection help to centrocytes. It is CXCR5-high, PD-1-high, ICOS-high and BCL6-high, and its light-zone localisation and selection function distinguish it from germinal-center T cells considered without regard to intra-germinal-center compartment.

**Parent (is_a):** germinal center T cell (CL:0009062)

**Anatomical location:** germinal center (UBERON:0010754)

**Logical axioms:**
- `part of` (BFO:0000050) some **germinal center** (UBERON:0010754) — Resides in the germinal center; specifically its light-zone compartment (see note).
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5** (PR:000001209) — CXCR5 (high) surface protein — follicle/GC homing.
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **programmed cell death protein 1** (PR:000001919) — PD-1 (high) surface protein — mature GC-Tfh marker.
- `has plasma membrane part` (RO:0002104) some **inducible T-cell costimulator** (PR:000001860) — ICOS (high) surface protein — GC-Tfh costimulation.

**Synonyms:**
- light zone germinal center T follicular helper cell (exact)
- light zone GC-Tfh (related)
- germinal center light zone T follicular helper cell (exact)

**References:**
- King et al. (2021). DOI: 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768 ; PMID:34623901 — Source single-cell atlas (Azimuth human_tonsil_v2).
- Chu et al. (2015). DOI: 10.1186/2051-1426-3-S2-P321 — Defines the canonical Tfh surface/transcription-factor phenotype (CXCR5-high, PD-1-high, Bcl-6+, CD4+) and states these cells reside in the germinal center where they act as specialized B helper T cells providing survival and selection signals to GC B cells. CXCR5 and PD-1 here refer to surface protein markers; Bcl-6 (BCL6) is an intracellular transcription factor. Also documents Tfh in human tonsillar tissue.
- Jing et al. (2022). DOI: 10.1016/j.celrep.2022.110763 ; PMID:35508132 — Describes the light-zone (LZ) as the germinal-center compartment where B cells bind FDC-presented antigen and are selected by T follicular helper (TFH) cell recognition of cognate peptide-MHCII. Establishes the core light-zone selection function of Tfh; markers referenced (pMHCII, TCR) are functional/interaction molecules, not transcriptional.
- Kennedy et al. (2020). DOI: 10.1038/s41590-020-0660-2 ; PMID:32341509 — Places Tfh help spatially in the light zone: LZ B cells capture antigen from FDCs and receive help from cognate Tfh cells, and are selected based on their competency to present antigen to Tfh. Strong T cell selection primes proliferation and re-entry into the dark zone. Confirms the light-zone localisation and selection-help function.
- Bracey et al. (2026). DOI: 10.64898/2026.04.03.715992 ; PMID:41993471 — In human tonsil, uses CXCR5 and PD-1 as established markers of Tfh cell maturation and shows GC-Tfh are the CXCR5+ PD-1-high population (with pre-Tfh being CXCR5+ PD-1-low). CXCR5 and PD-1 are measured here as surface proteins by intracellular cytokine staining / flow cytometry; CXCL13 marks an effector subset within GC-Tfh. Directly supports CXCR5-high, PD-1-high protein phenotype of light-zone GC-Tfh in human tonsil.
- Ribeiro et al. (2025). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.adt8901 ; PMID:40644556 — In human tonsil, defines Tfh by FOXP3-negative, CXCR5+ CD4 T cells and shows ICOS and PD-1 are characteristic of the most mature cells within the GC, with Tfh maturing toward an ICOS+ PD-1+ phenotype. ICOS, PD-1 and CXCR5 are surface protein markers; FOXP3 an intracellular transcription factor. Supports the protein-level activation/maturation phenotype of GC-localised Tfh in tonsil.
- Krishna et al. (2016). DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0200241 ; PMID:30138347 — Models affinity selection in the light zone as a competition between B cells binding Tfh cells (for costimulation) and loss of B cells from the GC light zone via apoptosis or return to the dark zone. Reinforces the mechanistic role of light-zone Tfh in affinity selection of centrocytes.

**Justification:** Light-zone refinement of CL:0009062 (germinal center T cell).
